verdict.rationale: Canny publishes an official MCP server that can be added to ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor with secure sign-in and no API keys. It supports both reading feedback (themes, ARR impact, roadmap) and acting on it (updating statuses, linking deals, replying to customers, sending conversations to Autopilot), and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP page exists. Missing for 10: in-depth technical MCP docs (tool reference, endpoint and auth-scope details) beyond marketing-page claims, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
